messages.author: 786a24990da9e91c
messages.subject: Problem using MatlabStan
parts:
Hi, thanks a lot for still developing new interface for Stan! After my first steps with rstan, I'd like to switch to Matlab (which I use more often). I downloaded and unzipped cmdstan (when I call "~/bin/cmdstan/bin/stanc --version", it is running and returns a proper version number) as well as the process manager and the MatlabStan package. However, if I try to compile a model from matlab, the following error appears and I have to admit, that I don't know how to proceed:

stanc version: /home/antonius/bin/cmdstan/bin/stanc: /usr/local/MATLAB/R2013a/sys/os/glnxa64/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.15' not found (required by /home/antonius/bin/cmdstan/bin/stanc)

Having a problem getting stan version. This is likely a problem with Java running out of file descriptors

Trying again.

stanc version: /home/antonius/bin/cmdstan/bin/stanc: /usr/local/MATLAB/R2013a/sys/os/glnxa64/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.15' not found (required by /home/antonius/bin/cmdstan/bin/stanc)

Trying again.


[...]

Output argument "ver" (and maybe others) not assigned during call to "/home/antonius/matlab_toolboxes/MatlabStan-master/StanModel.m>StanModel.stan_version".

Error in StanModel (line 194)
 ver = self.stan_version();

Error in stan (line 108)
 model = StanModel();

Error in test_stan (line 32)
fit = stan('model_code',schools_code,'data',schools_dat);




I am running Ubuntu 14.04, g++ 4.8.2, make 3.81, Matlab R2013a, Stan 2.5.0. 

Do you have any suggestions? Any advice is highly appreciated!

Cheers,
Antonius

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Problem using MatlabStan
parts:
It looks as if you need to update the system's standard C++ library, although I can't imagine how you could have gotten g++-4.8 without the corresponding C++ library.

On Debian unstable / testing, it would be

sudo apt-get instal llibstdc++-4.8-dev

but I don't know if that would work for Ubuntu 14.04. Here is a link

http://packages.ubuntu.com/search?keywords=libstdc%2B%2B

Ben

messages.author: 786a24990da9e91c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Problem using MatlabStan
parts:
Hi Ben, thanks for your quick reply! Unfortunately, the package
libstdc++-4.8-dev is already installed (version 4.8.2-19ubuntu1). I am
not very familiar with compiling, but I'm wondering why Stan is
linking to the libstdc++ that comes with Matlab. Just to check it: I
downloaded cmdstan, unzipped it. The Matlab interface seems to be not
working "out of the box", therefore I checked the cmdstan itself. I
ran "make stan/example-models/basic_distributions/normal" which
worked correctly and created the cmdstan/bin/stanc as well. Then
calling Stan from Matlab which results in the error above. Sorry, I am
a bit lost here. Do you habe any other suggestion?

Cheers,
Antonius

This might be related to Matlab changing a library path on startup. Have a look at this thread:

https://www.mathworks.com/matlabcentral/newsreader/view_thread/162466

Messages 13-18 seems promising. 

Best,
-b
